subject.title: Add auth sync command or auto-sync for API key rotation across agents

question: Which credential-rotation behavior should OpenClaw support for env/config key updates that are shadowed by stored auth profiles?
rationale: The implementation choice changes credential propagation, auth precedence, stale-secret recovery, and operator visibility, which are security and product-policy decisions rather than a safe automatic fix.

options.title: Audited sync or doctor warning
options.body: Add an explicit SQLite-backed rotation/sync command or `doctor`/status warning that reports affected agents and requires operator intent before changing stored credentials.

options.title: Auto-sync on config change
options.body: Fan out credential changes automatically when config/env keys change, improving convenience but silently copying secrets across agent stores.

options.title: Fallback after 401
options.body: Try env/config credentials after a stored profile fails auth, improving recovery but changing precedence and potentially masking stale stored credentials.

recommendation.title: Audited sync or doctor warning
recommendation.body: Add an explicit SQLite-backed rotation/sync command or `doctor`/status warning that reports affected agents and requires operator intent before changing stored credentials.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history trail for auth precedence and main-store read-through points to this area contributor.
